Done! All three functions are implemented and exported:

- **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — limits n to the range [min, max]
- **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats byte counts as B, KB, MB, or GB with one decimal place
- **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — converts text to lowercase, trims, replaces spaces with dashes, and removes non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes)

Changes logged in CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased].
